F100.1.text: Every report and every poster rebuttal triggers one read, after the report is stored; the report never waits

F100.10.text: Builder-built labelled set; licensed photos, licence per photo; children and adult cases handled safely

F100.11.text: Live needs ≥ 95% recall, 100% severity-1, < 10% false alarms, plus two weeks of shadow the PM read

F100.12.text: Suspected severity-1 never sent to a provider; images hash-checked; row goes to a person with the result

F100.2.text: Haiku with text and vision, structured: category, severity 1–4, confidence, outcome, reason ≤ 140

F100.3.text: Under 0.70 Sonnet gives a second opinion; both stored, second shown

F100.4.text: Send only content, reporter's reason, rebuttal; no name, handle or email; rules versioned

F100.5.text: Each assessment stores model, prompt version, category, severity, confidence, outcome, reason, latency, time; RLS on, no policies

F100.6.text: Shadow mode: an assessment changes nothing (but F102's severity-4 auto-restore)

F100.7.text: A person's decision is logged against the AI suggestion

F100.8.text: Live mode is a data switch; live raises severity and order; remove, restore, strikes stay a person's

F100.9.text: Harness prints recall, false alarms, severity accuracy, latency, cost; runs on every prompt change

F101.13.text: Severity 1–3 thumbnails blurred until pressed and held; severity 4 plain

F101.6.text: Swipe right approves, left removes, colour and word revealed

F102.2.text: Fix and repost shows again at once; reports stay; no second repost; not for severity 1

F102.3.text: Say it's wrong: Mistaken/Malicious/Misusing + 280-char note; one per hide; to AI and row; stays hidden

F102.4.text: Unanswered hide stays hidden, closes at 14 days; batch shows it only if severity 1

F102.5.text: Per-reporter counters (filed, upheld, dismissed, open), operator-only, used by nothing else

F102.6.text: Cap 5, drops to 1 after any dismissal in 30 days

F102.7.text: Two dismissals in 30 days start a 14-day cool-down; stored and queued, hide nothing; three strikes above

F102.8.text: 3+ reports on a poster in 24h, 2 from accounts under 7 days: flag, +1 tier in severity

F102.9.text: Tue-Thu with no person: sev 2-4 wait; sev 1 stays hidden and texts the PM
